development.intended: A physical phone oscillated in the past. It belongs to a person identified in context. Do not invent an owner or imply an audible ring.
Dialogue identifies a particular chair by a fault. The speaker points it out. It can still be sat on. Breakage alone does not mean a visible crack.
The previously active pulse stopped occurring. It may come back. No agent, deletion or permanent destruction is implied.
There was another occurrence of the retries. No one is said to initiate it and no exact count is given.
The pulse occurred again. In this scene it did not travel back to a place. If the line alone is ambiguous, ask which kind of return was meant.
The arrival caused another instance of the preceding pulse. Outside the preceding scene the referent of it needs clarification.
The speaker reassures someone who warned about a faulty chair. Literal physical repair would change the meaning.
The counter deferred acting. It was not switched off or established to have stopped existing.

development.line: Pip found a cracked bell. They repaired it before Ada arrived.
development.intended: Pip discovered one bell with a material fissure. The same Pip repaired that same bell. The repair precedes Ada's arrival. All three reported actions are past.
At least one of the specified bells did not ring. Zero ringing bells is consistent. No claim that any rang.
Zero of the specified bells rang. Distinct from the weaker statement that not every bell rang.

reserved.intended: The prior return path allowed passage. The isolated pronoun and the kind of openness need context.
The speaker orders the listener to find something already under discussion. Ask which thing when the isolated line gives no referent.
The resumed request occurred again. Standing alone, it needs a referent. The original author did not assert an agent caused it.
The speaker already registered the relevant fact. The object comes from context. Do not silently substitute a different event.
The routine pulled back from contact in the past. The line gives no physical destination or explicit source.

reserved.line: Ada noticed a cracked radio and repaired it.
reserved.intended: Ada noticed a radio with a fissure and repaired that same radio. The omitted second subject is Ada. And alone supplies no strict order.

reserved.line: The bell rang after Mira arrived.
reserved.intended: The bell resonated in the past. Mira’s arrival precedes the ringing even though it is mentioned second.

second_reserve.intended: The request stopped occurring. Its permanent deletion and a stopping agent are unspecified.
Latch discovered the particular result in the scene. A mere change of opinion would be weaker.
The Council deferred acting. This group is identified by its name in the narrative.
The child brought about another occurrence of the same tone. It need not be the first producer.
A previously mentioned individual deferred acting. In isolation ask whom he refers to.
Hinge sent excess allocation back. An intransitive recurrence or personal journey would lose the target.

second_reserve.line: Elias expected it to repeat the old conclusion.
second_reserve.intended: Elias expected a repetition by another participant. The expectation must not be rendered as a repetition that occurred.

final_reserve.line: I restored the resistance and waited.
final_reserve.intended: The narrator restored the resistance. The same narrator waited. The conjunction alone does not require a strict temporal order.
Another occurrence of the same tone took place. No explicit producer or repeat count.
The narrator produced another occurrence of a previously mentioned pattern. Ask what it refers to in an isolated line.
A calculation produced a numeric result. Neither movement of the resolver nor recurrence is intended.
